title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

title: NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026 – Laboratory Technician, Staff Nurse, Medical Officer, ANM & Other (walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: NHM Dhamtari has announced notification for Laboratory Technician, Staff Nurse, Medical Officer, ANM & Other (walk-in) posts. Required qualification: BHMS, BAMS, 12TH, B.Sc, BUMS, BMLT, ANM, GNM, M.Sc, 10TH, BPT, M.A, DMLT. Last date to apply: 31-08-26.
howToApply: Candidates must appear for walk-in interview on the scheduled date and time at the District Health Office (CMHO Office), Dhamtari.
Report at the venue between 09:00 AM and the specified time for document verification and registration.
Bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies for verification.
Details and schedule are available on the official website: www.dhamtari.gov.in
No separate call letter will be issued; this notification serves as the interview call.
Candidates must fill the application form available at the venue or downloadable from the official website.

title: Punjab Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026 – Group D (Safai Sewak, Chowkidar) Posts
shortInfo: Punjab Vidhan Sabha has announced notification for Group D (Safai Sewak, Chowkidar) posts. Required qualification: 10TH. Last date to apply: 27-08-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: https://punjabassembly.gov.in/public/jobs
Click on ‘Apply’ for the relevant post.
Enter a valid email ID and mobile number, then click ‘Get OTP’.
Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click ‘Verify OTP’.
Fill in Basic Details, Contact Details, Category, Educational Qualifications, and other required information.
Upload scanned copies of recent passport size photograph (jpg, max 2MB) and signature (jpg, max 2MB).
Upload required documents including Domicile Certificate, Nationality, Disability Certificate (if applicable), Punjabi Proficiency Verification, etc.
Enter the Captcha, select the Declaration checkbox, and click ‘Preview & Submit’.
Review the information in the Preview section. Click ‘Edit’ if changes are needed, otherwise click ‘Confirm & Submit’.
Proceed to online payment by clicking ‘Pay Now’ and pay the fee using available online payment modes (UPI, QR Code, etc.).
Download and print the payment receipt and submitted application form after successful payment.

vacancyList.postName: Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders)

howToApply: Register on the appropriate portal: NAPS (http://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/) for Trade Apprentices (ITI & Data Entry Operator) or NATS (https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php) for Technician and Graduate Apprentices.
Ensure 100% completion/updation of your profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, Aggregate Percentage) on the respective portal.
Login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and apply for the apprenticeship openings using the Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005 / NAPS – E05200700003.

After applying on the NATS/NAPS portal, also submit your details along with preferred State and three preferred locations in the Microsoft Office Form at: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c by 06.09.2026, 05:00 PM.
Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE. Multiple discipline code applications will be summarily rejected.
Ensure you have a valid PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, active Aadhaar-seeded bank account enabled for DBT, and APAAR ID updated on NATS portal.
Applications must be submitted on or before 06th September 2026 at 05:00 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

title: RailTel Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice Engineer, Diploma Apprentice Engineer Posts
shortInfo: RailTel has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice Engineer, Diploma Apprentice Engineer posts. Required qualification: Degree in Engineering, Diploma in Engineering. Last date to apply: 27-08-26.
howToApply: Visit the NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in.
If not already registered, register yourself on the NATS 2.0 portal before applying.
Follow the guidelines given in the student manual of NATS available at the portal (web link: https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/establishment_user_manual.pdf).
Fill in the online application form with accurate details.

Upload the certificate showing your CGPA or percentage in the ‘Upload Certificate’ column. If only CGPA is mentioned, also upload the CGPA to percentage conversion formula/certificate along with the undertaking (Annexure 1) as a single PDF file of size less than 1 MB.
Submit the application online before the last date of 27.08.2026.
No other mode of application will be entertained.
